abstract: Sperm counts were low (median, 15 X 10(6) per ejaculate) and serum follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels were moderately elevated (median, 31 IU/l) after unilateral orchiectomy and immediately before radiotherapy and chemotherapy in 34 patients with seminomas and 20 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The scattered radiation (0.2 to 1.3 Gray [Gy]) reaching the remaining testicle during radiotherapy caused azoospermia in more than two thirds of the patients. A median of 540 days elapsed after the end of treatment before spermatozoa were again found in semen samples, while a median of 1250 days passed before the pretreatment sperm count was reached. One to 5 years after treatment, sperm counts were still low (median, 6 X 10(6) per ejaculate) and serum FSH was elevated (median, 61 IU/l). The adjuvant chemotherapy given to the 20 patients with nonseminomatous tumors did not appear to affect restitution appreciably.
abstract_ja: 片側精巣摘除術後、放射線療法および化学療法の直前に、セミノーマ患者34例および非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者20例で精子数と血清卵胞刺激ホルモン(FSH)値を測定した。精子数は低値(中央値 1,500万/射精)、FSHは中等度の上昇(中央値 31 IU/l)であった。放射線療法中に残存精巣へ到達した散乱放射線(0.2〜1.3 Gy)により、患者の3分の2以上で無精子症が生じた。治療終了後に精子が再び精液中に認められるまで中央値540日を要し、治療前の精子数に戻るまでには中央値1250日を要した。非セミノーマ患者20例に施行された補助化学療法は、精子数の回復にほとんど影響を及ぼさなかったと考えられる。治療後1〜5年の時点でも精子数は低値のまま(中央値 600万/射精)、血清FSHは上昇したまま(中央値 61 IU/l)であった。
